invariants.description: costs (exact): J_keep = n L (c_poly + c_deg + c_recycle) k_deg f_ATP / N_A, J_demand = r_up n_0 L (c_syn + c_poly) / N_A, J_build = J_demand s_build min(f_ATP, 1), M_build = n L (c_syn + c_poly) / N_A, A_protein = n_0 footprint m
invariants.expr: np.allclose(J_keep, n_0*m*L*(c_poly + c_deg + c_recycle)*k_deg/N_A*f_ATP, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_demand, np.maximum(m_target - m, 0)/tau*n_0*L*(c_syn + c_poly)/N_A, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(J_build, J_demand*s_build*np.minimum(f_ATP, 1), rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(M_build, n_0*m*L*(c_syn + c_poly)/N_A, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(A_protein, n_0*footprint*1e-6*m, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.description: the copies built are paid for: n_0 L (c_syn + c_poly) / N_A (m(t) - m(0)) = int J_build dt while m rises (relative 1e-4: trapezoid integration of the logged flux)
invariants.expr: abs(n_0*L*(c_syn + c_poly)/N_A*(m[-1] - m[0]) - np.trapz(J_build, t)) <= 1e-4*abs(np.trapz(J_build, t)) + 1e-30

invariants.description: expression approaches its target and never overshoots: m moves monotonically towards m_target
invariants.expr: np.all(np.diff(m)*np.sign(m_target - m[0]) >= -1e-12) and np.all((m - m_target)*(m[0] - m_target) >= -1e-12)

bc_sweep.rationale: expression over the range the game offers (x0.25-4); ATP from near exhaustion to above rest; synthesis from stalled to unconstrained
